APPROVE: Moving the ternaries, `&&` chains and lambda into `ToContainer` removes their cognitive-complexity cost from `Parse`, which should bring it from 16 to 15 or lower. The call sits at the same spot inside the existing try/catch, so evaluation order and exception handling are unchanged, and the helper uses only members already in the class, so the build should not break.

I judged this from the diff alone. I did not build the project or run the analyzer.
